items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Well at that time he had, well I've been playing with Buddy Petit. He had a fella by the name of George Washington was playing trombone.

ctx.x: About three years? Mm-hmm. And how was his band? Who was in his band at that time?
Well at that time he had, well I've been playing with Buddy Petit. He had a fella by the name of George Washington was playing trombone.
He had Buddy Matty was playing banjo. Little Chester was playing bass. And Little Pills was playing clarinet.
